changes.title: Details on Ed Sheeran tour as all acts quit after Macklemore dropped for pro-Palestine comments
changes.summary: Ed Sheeran is facing intense public backlash after rapper Macklemore, who was set to open his upcoming tour dates, was dropped from the production over pro-Palestine comments. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports and Alex Suskind, news director at online music magazine Pitchfork, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

changes.title: Multiple artists quit Ed Sheeran tour
changes.summary: Major acts touring with Ed Sheeran have quit after rapper Macklemore was forced out due to his support of Palestinians. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda has the story.

changes.title: Ed Sheeran’s Opening Acts Drop out in Solidarity With Macklemore
changes.summary: Fallout is growing over rapper Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour with now every one of Sheeran’s music openers and his onstage band announcing that they would no longer take part in the tour. Sheeran is also speaking out, saying “Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter’s decision, it was not mine.” NBC’s.
